title: Deep Belt
game_overview: Pilot the Ferrier mining frigate in the Harrow system. Warp to belts, lock targets, cycle mining lasers, and dock at Harrow Station to trade ore and fit upgraded ship modules.
winning_condition: None (sandbox economic and mining progression in the Harrow system).
losing_condition: None (peaceful exploration, mining, and module fitting).

controls.input: WASD / Arrow Keys / Left-Click Empty Space
controls.action: Fly ship in space (W thrust, S brake, A/D turn); Left-click empty space flies to that point
Select object; Tab cycles nearest targets with target bracket
Open Warp Menu [M]; number keys 1-9 select destination, Enter confirms
Dock [F] when in range; Undock [U] from station
Open Wreck [E] in space (<=2km) / Use nearest terminal [E] when docked
Help [H]; Esc closes top menu/help or re-opens game menu without double-toggle

controls.input: Docked: A/D or Left/Right / Click Floor
controls.action: Pilot walks corridor; Terminal menus: 1-4 switch tabs, Arrows+Enter select, Esc closes

sections.title: Docked Tutorial Coach Responsive Gutter Layout
sections.content:
Docked Training Coach Viewport & Panel Clearance Architecture:
1. Corridor Mode (`stationTab === 'DOCK'`):
   - Renders the full 260px Cel Ink tutorial coach card at `left: 16px, top: 56px, width: 260px, height: 116px, zIndex: 55`, cleanly clear of the bottom tab bar (`top: 712px`), Undock [U], and officer speech.
2. Active Station Terminal Panel Mode (`stationTab !== 'DOCK'`):
   - When any terminal modal (Market, Fitting, Hangar, Fabricator, Schematics, Agent, Skills) is active at `left: 96px, top: 60px`, the coach card dynamically transitions into the dedicated 96px left margin gutter at `left: 8px, top: 56px, width: 80px, maxHeight: 220px, zIndex: 55`.
   - With an 80px card width and 4px offset shadow (ending at x: 92px), a clean 4px clearance gap is preserved before the panel boundary at x: 96px, completely preventing overlap with panel headers, officer dialogue, tab chips, and the Market 'Sell all [S]' action.
   - Typographic scaling: Content wraps cleanly in the gutter (compact step indicator, pips, title, instruction key chips, and Skip [T] button) ensuring complete guidance accessibility across 1280x800 and 1024x640 viewports.
sections.summary: Dynamically shifts docked coach card into an 80px left gutter at left: 8px when terminal panels are open, preventing panel overlap while keeping full 260px card in corridor.
